moneySafetyConvergence.statement: The chain is money-safe BOTH ways. (a) AT-MOST-ONCE: release is called ONLY at bank-watcher.mjs:43, inside the `if (plan.outcome !== "send")` branch (line 40) which returns at line 44 BEFORE the adapter loop begins (line 51). There is NO release call on the adapter-throw path (line 60-63), the no-adapter path (line 53-54), the markPaid-throw path (line 71-73), or anywhere after a dispatch. Therefore a row that entered the adapter call can NEVER be released-to-clean; it remains 'processing' for reconciliation. Additionally the dispatch guard parseBankRecipient (bank-recipients.mjs:24) refuses any row carrying `ref=` OR `claimed_at=`, so a row that ever entered the dispatch boundary is never auto-redispatched even if flipped to 'queued'. The r9 FIND-109 fix did NOT reopen the double-pay path. (b) AT-LEAST-ONCE-FOR-SKIPPED: a recipient skipped for below_reserve/insufficient_balance/etc. is released with buildReleasePatch(r.raw) (bank-payout-watcher.mjs:43,146) which sets { status:'queued', notes: raw }, restoring the ORIGINAL signup notes and STRIPPING the claimed_at the claim stamped. r.raw is provably clean: parseBankRecipient rejects any row with ref/claimed_at at line 24 BEFORE assigning raw=row.notes at line 31, so raw can never itself carry those markers. The restored row re-parses as a payable recipient (FIND-109 test bank-payout-watcher.test.js:28-33) and is payable on a later pass — no payout loss. The only remaining items are the FIND-104-class live-API-gated limitations (queryStatus / 残高照会 endpoint shapes + per-item status granularity), unverifiable without a real GMO_AOZORA_ACCESS_TOKEN. CONVERGENCE REACHED.

findingStatus.FIND-104: OPEN, CARRIED OVER as the documented live-API-gated convergence ceiling. queryStatus (bank-payout-watcher.mjs:155-167) and getBalance (line 200-222) remain EXPLICITLY UNVERIFIED GMO endpoint shapes (markers at lines 155, 206) and queryStatus is batch-granular. NOTE: FIND-105's downstream-amplification concern (a false 'failed' feeding a re-dispatch) is now NEUTRALIZED — even if an operator re-queues a needs_review row, parseBankRecipient:24 refuses it because it still carries claimed_at/ref. So FIND-104 reverts to a pure low-severity verification-gated limitation. Cannot be closed without a real token.

newFlawFromR9Edit: NONE FOUND. Traced: (1) release default `async () => {}` (bank-watcher.mjs:23) only no-ops the skip path when a caller omits release; such rows stay 'processing' and are caught by reconcileStuck->needs_review (no loss, no double-pay) — and the live pass() always supplies release (line 235). (2) The live release loop (bank-payout-watcher.mjs:145-147) patches by id without a &status guard, but it is only ever called on rows THIS pass just claimed-and-did-not-dispatch (held in 'processing'; no concurrent pass can re-claim them because the claim CAS filters status=eq.queued at line 140), so the unconditional status='queued' reset is safe. (3) buildReleasePatch falls back to { status:'queued' } (no notes reset) only when raw is falsy; the live recipients always carry raw (bank-recipients.mjs:31), so the live path always strips claimed_at. The fallback is a tested degenerate branch (bank-payout-watcher.test.js:25) that cannot occur on the live skip path.
convergenceCeilingStatement: All RESOLVABLE issues are closed. The chain is money-safe at-most-once (no double-pay) and at-least-once-for-skipped (no payout-loss). The ONLY remaining items are FIND-104-class live-API-gated limitations: the GMO bulktransfer/status (queryStatus) and 残高照会 (getBalance) endpoint paths/response shapes and per-item status granularity are UNVERIFIABLE without a real GMO_AOZORA_ACCESS_TOKEN (sunabar sandbox or 法人 account). These are the honest convergence ceiling and cannot be closed until the token exists.

evidence.description: Design invariant 'release returns to queued ONLY on a pre-dispatch skip (nothing was sent)' (header line 9) is implemented exactly: release is in the plan.outcome!=='send' branch and returns before the adapter loop.

Dispatch-boundary dedupe (FIND-105/107) implemented: parseBankRecipient refuses any row with ref= OR claimed_at=, so anything that entered dispatch is never auto-redispatched — matching the design comment.
FIND-109 intent (a skipped recipient must remain payable; restore original notes to strip claimed_at) implemented in buildReleasePatch.

Adapter-failure (FIND-B) and markPaid-failure (FIND-007) both assert released===[] (no auto-requeue of sent money); below_reserve skip (FIND-C, line 61-77) asserts released===['a','b'] (skipped rows returned to queue).

FIND-109 edge: buildReleasePatch(raw) returns clean notes (no claimed_at) AND parseBankRecipient re-parses the restored notes — the at-least-once-for-skipped invariant is directly tested, not tautological.
FIND-105 (ref=) and FIND-107 (claimed_at, no ref) both asserted REFUSED, while a fresh notes row still parses — the at-most-once dispatch-guard edges are covered on both markers.

No-double-pay invariants verified line-by-line: atomic claim subset dispatch (31-35), skip-only release before adapter loop (40-44), no-requeue-on-adapter-throw (58-64), no-requeue-on-markPaid-throw (67-74). A sent row is unreachable by release.

claim stamps notes=raw+claimed_at (139); release restores notes=raw via buildReleasePatch (43,146), stripping claimed_at symmetrically (claim patches status+notes; release patches status+notes). r.raw is provably clean per bank-recipients.mjs:24->31.
Pure planner integer-yen split + reserve/fee/min/balance guards correct; insufficient_balance/below_reserve return outcome!=='send' which routes to the safe release path.

Pure helpers (buildReleasePatch/buildSubmittedPatch/buildClaimPatch/claimedFromRows/claimWith/parseRef/parseClaimedAt/reconcileStuck/pollCompletions/idempotencyKey/todayYmd/makeGmoAdapter) remain cleanly separated from live Supabase/GMO wiring (126-242). The r9 edit added a single parameter to buildReleasePatch and threaded r.raw through release; no dead code, no orphan refs introduced.

release(claimed) now passes full recipient objects (carrying raw) instead of ids, consistent with claim(recipients) which also takes objects; the seam is symmetric and the rawById map (47) reuses the same .raw for markPaid.

queryStatus and getBalance remain EXPLICITLY UNVERIFIED GMO endpoints (UNVERIFIED markers at lines 155, 206) and queryStatus is batch-granular (one status string applied to every row sharing a ref). Cannot be verified without a live GMO_AOZORA_ACCESS_TOKEN. This is the documented, honest convergence ceiling — NOT a resolvable in-repo defect. Its prior amplification via FIND-105 is now neutralized by the claimed_at/ref dispatch guard (bank-recipients.mjs:24).
